name: Delete an automation
Retrieve a list of automations
description: Retrieve a list of automations GET /automations
context:
GET /automations
Retrieve a list of automations
Optional: status (query) — Filter automations by status.; limit (query) — Number of items to return.; after (query) — Return items after this cursor.; before (query) — Return items before this cursor.

name: Retrieve a single automation
Retrieve a list of automation runs
description: Retrieve a list of automation runs GET /automations/{automation_id}/runs
context:
GET /automations/{automation_id}/runs
Retrieve a list of automation runs
Required: automation_id (path) — The ID of the automation.
Optional: status (query) — Filter runs by status. Comma-separated list of: running, completed, failed, cancelled.; limit (query) — Number of items to return.; after (query) — Return items after this cursor.; before (query) — Return items before this cursor.
